note: Sherman County, TX has no published county zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The only incorporated city with zoning is Stratford (county seat), whose zoning map is published only as a PDF (stratfordtx.us/zoning-map). No ArcGIS service found for Sherman County or Stratford. The Sherman, TX ArcGIS zoning layers found belong to the City of Sherman in Grayson County, not this county. Texhoma publishes no zoning layer found.
